entries.reason: Legacy module-id ordering and importer-relative path inference remain available only as an explicit migration opt-in while all implicit construction uses import order and resolved dependency authority.
The query facade defaults to linked order; import-inline execution remains available only through the explicitly named compatibility constructor.
CLI bundle construction now selects linked emission unless the deprecated legacy flag or matching configuration key is explicitly present.
Node callers use linked emission through the established bundle export; the old path is isolated behind a named legacy export with generated deprecation documentation.
Browser callers use linked emission through the established bundle export; the old path is isolated behind a named deprecated legacy export.
The JS adapter rebinds buildBundleSources to linked emission and exposes import-inline behavior only through the deprecated legacyEmission option.
Vite inherits the linked JS-adapter default and can request import-inline behavior only through the deprecated legacyEmission option.
The PostCSS plugin delegates to the linked JS-adapter default and can request import-inline behavior only through the deprecated legacyEmission option.
